newsitem.title: USA: Dollar drips lower in late U.S., stops triggered.
newsitem.headline: Dollar drips lower in late U.S., stops triggered.

text.p: *Dlr falls past stops at 115.80 yen, 1.7960 marks. Big seller at 116.40 yen, triggers slide with failed break of 1.80 marks.
*Big rally, possibly troubling Japan trade data tonight spark profit-taking. No follow-through on Waigel rally also cited.
*Waigel said strong economies lift dollar, stg, not a concern.
*Buba intervention seen unlikely here. Possible near 1.83.
